prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome your pet to your desktop screen!", "Click and drag your new companion anywhere on your desktop screen."]
1: ["Preview your companion's daily habits", "See how virtual pets interact with your desktop apps, play games, and respond to your work day.", "Choose Your Path"]
2: ["Signing in backs up your pet's memory and state so it is never lost when reopening the desktop app."]
3: ["Select or craft your ideal companion", "Choose a pre-made pet or generate a unique companion from your photos."]
4: ["Setting up your desktop pet engine...", "We are preparing your pet's desktop rendering engine and animation states."]
5: ["Quick Desktop Controls", "Here is how to interact with your pet once it lands on your desktop.", "Right-click pet for main menu; Click & drag to move pet; Double-click to trigger pet trick.", "Launch Desktop Pet"]
6: ["Select your companion creation method", "Pick a classic ready-to-play pet for instant launch, or generate a custom pet from your photos in under 1 minute.", "Continue with Path"]
7: ["Upload photos for custom pet generation"]
8: ["Sign in to activate companion sync", "Create or sign into your account to save your companion across desktop launches."]
9: ["Preparing your desktop companion", "Did you know? You can minimize your pet to the system tray anytime."]
